prompt:
Create ONE polished, highly legible Simplified Chinese editorial infographic, requested landscape 3840x2160 or highest practical resolution, about a research archive for AI video creation. This is an explanatory poster, not a website screenshot. Warm ivory paper, deep forest green typography, sage panels, restrained orange for caveats, generous white space, crisp modern Chinese sans-serif. Accurate Chinese text is crucial. Use thin arrows and small elegant original illustrations of perfume/ripple, a book and sewing needle, a ceramic cup, a commuter walking beside a bicycle. Illustrations are conceptual icons, not claimed real generated-video evidence. No decorative nonsense text, no invented capabilities. All listed text must be verbatim and readable. Strong hierarchy: large title, medium section titles, readable body. Do not cram tiny footnotes.

Top:
large title "视频创作 · 动作素材库"
subtitle "以情绪需要选动作，用提示词配合大模型生成"
small archive badge "阶段归档 · 按需重启"
stat strip "424项电影语言参考  /  7项结构化规则  /  4个实测题材  /  1次局部返修"

Central broad flow, prominent heading "原理：从想让人感受到什么，走到画面里发生什么"
five readable nodes connected left to right:
"创作目标与情绪" → "情境与动作" → "镜头与参考" → "双语提示词" → "视频模型生成"
one return arrow underneath labelled "审动作 · 看情绪 · 记问题 · 回库复用"
role line: "库提供参考与经验  ·  语言模型负责选择和设计  ·  视频模型负责生成画面"

Middle lower four equal cards, heading "我们实际探索过的动作与表达"
card 1 "香水 · 16秒" / "雨滴涟漪 · 倒影变化" / "产品环绕 · 留白" / small caveat "图形匹配仅部分符合"
card 2 "旧书 · 18秒" / "刷拭 · 穿针" / "合书 · 交还" / small caveat "孔位与合书返修有改善"
card 3 "陶器 · 15秒" / "触杯 · 端杯行走" / "停步 · 窗边停留" / small caveat "停止与跨镜连续性有偏差"
card 4 "取车 · 20秒" / "抬眼回应 · 擦座垫" / "扶稳交接 · 车旁推行" / small caveat "次数、握持与起步有偏差"

Bottom two blocks:
"价值" / "让创作有依据，让动作可检查，让经验能复用"
"后期扩展" / "动作视频参考 · 统一角色与物体 · 模型检索与编排 · 生成对照与观众反馈"
Final full-width calm amber boundary strip:
"当前边界：提示词与参考会影响结果，模型也可能不遵守；单次观察不代表稳定能力。"
"424项含运镜、光线、构图等，不能视为424个已验证人物动作。"

Keep clear layout and correct arrow semantics. The key message is a creative action reference and experience library driven by emotion and action, working with language and video models. It does not itself generate or deterministically control videos.
notes: 示意插画，不是四套实际视频的证据帧。
文字以app/archive-summary.json和网页为准确来源；信息图本身不增加实测案例数。
